Who We Are

Built on disciplined distribution, trusted relationships, and long-term market growth.

Raj Agencies was founded by Mr. Alpesh D. Jogani and Mr. Rakesh V. Jogani with a clear vision to build a dependable, growth-driven distribution network for automotive spare parts. The company supports two-wheelers, cars, HCV and LCV vehicles, tractors, earthmovers, agriculture, industrial hardware, and utility vehicle segments.

Why Raj Agencies Exists: to deliver reliability, structured service, and practical growth support to every market partner.

“Long-term growth starts with trust, timely service, and disciplined execution on the ground.”

Raj Agencies leadership philosophy
